items.text: KLAY’s MCAM study, “Structural Basis for MCAM Mediated Inhibition of Laminin Dependent Cell Migration,” is now available as a bioRxiv preprint.
Klein Lab receives a 2nd Blavatnik Award for developing ROS1 biologics to treat cancer, following a first-place prize in 2023.
Nature Communications paper accepted, describing the structural basis for regulating oncogene ROS1 activity.
Klein Lab awarded the Golden Token by Connecticut Innovations and Yale Ventures to support the foundation of a newco spinout.
